name: Basque Chicken and Peppers (Pollo al Chilindron)

fit.note: 452.5 cal within 400-650; 6.6g carb well under 35g ceiling; no seafood; bone-in-thigh braise scales to 14 by weigh-and-divide from the pot.

dupe_check.catalog: Not a duplicate. Closest catalog chicken dishes are Slow Cooker Chicken Cacciatore Pasta (Italian herb-tomato braise over penne with mushrooms - starch base + different flavor family), Hungarian Chicken Paprikash (creamy sour-cream paprika over egg noodles - no peppers, no tomato-pepper base), and Puerto Rican Pollo Guisado (Caribbean sofrito/sazon stew with potatoes and olives). Shares only chicken+tomato+peppers with cacciatore (2 of 4); sauce family (Spanish smoked-paprika + jamon + white wine) and no-starch plate make it a distinct dinner.
dupe_check.accepted_slugs: No collision - accepted chicken slugs are tuscan skillet, bacon-ranch cauliflower bake, french fricassee, burmese dal curry, jalapeno-popper casserole, chicken marsala; none is a Spanish/Basque tomato-pepper braise.

cuisine_value: Fills a Basque/Spanish gap the catalog lacks (catalog skews American/Tex-Mex); widens spread.
cross_protein_collisions: Structurally a paprika-tomato-pepper braise. Watch for same-dish-different-protein twins in other selectors' pools: a pork/sausage 'peppers and onions' paprika braise (catalog already has Polish Leczo kielbasa-and-peppers and Szegedin pork goulash - different proteins, not this recipe's dupe but same skeleton), or a turkey 'sausage and peppers' braise. If another selector KEEPs a chicken tomato-pepper braise (cacciatore-style, chilindron-style) the decider should compare directly.
